method: Both policies play the same independently generated 80-tile synthetic boards through the unmodified reference simulator, with the same initial hand and per-step RNG seeds. Only current + 4 rows are passed to either policy. Reference uses its public UI Normal/Smart/Save upgrades settings and its UI three-cycle guard. No reference code or odds copied into product.
limitations: Controlled synthetic tile mixture, not server layouts or real profit.
Question events and special boards excluded.
RNG seeds are paired per decision; differing actions can consume different numbers of random draws.
Finite sample Monte Carlo: matching decisions or superiority are not guaranteed.
This compares solver decisions with public UI defaults, not complete live reader/application behaviour.

qualityGate.scope: Only this controlled generator and reference settings; not live-game or server-layout parity.

timingScope: Concurrent benchmark shards; calculation times are not an isolated latency measurement.
